name: Neural Gaussian Rasterization Pipeline
definition: A rendering pipeline that replaces the standard exponential opacity formulation with direct neural network outputs for per-Gaussian opacity and color, while retaining the standard 2D Gaussian rasterizer for compositing.
summary: The Neural Gaussian Rasterization Pipeline replaces standard opacity with neural network outputs for per-Gaussian density and color, decoupling appearance from geometry to enable higher-fidelity reconstruction of complex materials and lighting effects.
